title: Unbound Adventures Into the Unknown
description: Unbound Adventures: Into the Unknown blends exploration, tech, magic, and space travel. Build with Create, cast spells with Ars Nouveau, and manage your loot with powerful storage mods.
body:
From the creators of Unbound Adventures and Unbound Horizons comes a new adventure waiting for you! 

Unbound Adventures: Into the Unknown expands on the previous exploration, tech, and magic mods but also allows you to explore the vast expanse of space as well! From creating giants moving parts with the Create Mod to casting spells on mods and friends alike with Ars Nouveau to can do anything you set your mind to. UA:ITU also has a number of storage options for you as well such as Applied Energistics, Functional Storage, Sophisticated Storage, as well as RF Tools Storage.

Come, Explore, Colonize! The universe is yours!
